resume: A physically modelled kalimba: the 16 white keys are the tines, the 11 black keys play rolled chords. Sound hole to cover, grains, tape, delay and plate reverb.

commandes.role: Octave down (from -2 to +2).
Octave up (from -2 to +2). OCT- and OCT+ held together for five seconds open firmware update mode.
Space page (Reverb, Size, Delay, Time); a second press, Color page (Tape, Lo-fi, Chorus, Filter).
Keys page (Layout, Scale, Key, Black; in Keyboard: Layout, Transpose, Octave); a second press, Play page (Strum ms, Octave).
Body page: Body (None, Board, Box, Gourd), Buzz, Wah, Wah rate.
Grain page (Grains, Grain ms, Density, Pitch); a second press, Spread page (Spray, Feedback, Width).
Cycles through all the pages in turn.
Setup page: Tune, MIDI ch, MIDI out, Theme. The header shows the version and CPU load.
Tine page (Material, Hardness, Decay, Tone); a second press, Character page (Worn, Glide, Tuning, Release).
Saves right away. Held 1.5 seconds, offers a return to factory settings: SAVE confirms, any other button or five seconds of waiting cancels.
Short press: starts or stops the mbira pattern (lit while it runs). Held half a second: opens the Pattern page without starting or stopping it.
Pattern page: Pattern (Thumbs, Cascade, 3 over 2, Interlock) and Tempo (40 to 200 BPM).
Freezes the grain cloud, which keeps playing what it has in memory; a second press returns it to live. Lit while frozen.
Palm mute: silences all the tines at once.
Volume.
Tine material: Steel, Brass, Bronze, Aluminium, Bamboo, Glass.
Key in Tine layout, transposition in Keyboard layout.
Scale (Major, Minor, Penta, Dorian, Mbira, Chromatic, etc.).
The 16 tines. In Tine layout, the lowest (C4 in C) is just right of center and the scale spreads out alternating left, right.
Depending on Black (Keys page): Chords, rolled chords on the scale degrees (the first seven keys play triads, the last four sevenths); Sharps, chromatic row; Perform, playing gestures.

gestes: ARP held half a second: opens the Pattern page.
SAVE held 1.5 seconds then SAVE: resets the sound settings to default.
OCT- and OCT+ held five seconds: update mode.
A page button pressed twice: moves to the next page of the same button.

modes.texte: 17-tine kalimba in C (D6 to C6, without the E6). The lowest tine is just right of center, the scale alternates to the left then the right. Mirror is the same layout reversed.
All 27 keys, white and black, play the printed note, from F3 to G5. Transpose shifts by plus or minus 12 semitones.

Key 1: mutes all the tines. Key 2: covers the hole while held. Key 3: freezes the grains. Key 4: octave down while held. Key 5: octave up while held. Keys 6 to 11: Steel, Brass, Bronze, Aluminium, Bamboo, Glass.

Cycle of 12 pulses, three per beat, in four patterns: Thumbs, Cascade, 3 over 2, Interlock. The chord comes from a black key in Chords mode, from held keys in Keyboard layout, or from held MIDI notes. It keeps going after release until another chord or a new press of ARP.

a_savoir: The FM-1 keys don't sense strike force: each key plucks with the same force, set by Hardness. Over MIDI, velocity sets it.
Settings save themselves about four seconds after a change, once everything is quiet.
Sixteen tines sound at once; the seventeenth replaces the weakest.
